title: Lists (vector)
instructions: A vector is a list of boxes, all of the same type. std::vector<int> scores{3, 7, 5}; makes a list of three whole numbers.
scores.push_back(9); adds a new box to the end of the list.
scores.size() tells you how many boxes are in the list right now.
task: Add 9 to the end of the list, so the program prints:  4 scores
hint:
push_back adds to the end:

    scores.push_back(9);
